Olivia: Quick heads-up — I'm putting together the offsite runbook for annual planning week. Need AV lead volunteers, facilitator rotation, and a short tech pre-check timeline. Aim: make Day 0 dry-run + rapid ideation scripts. Thoughts?
Tia: I can own AV runbook + vendor liaisons. Have checklist from last year we can reuse.
Michael: I'll take facilitator rota for product breakout rooms. Suggest 20m intros + 40m ideation + 15m synth per session.
Olivia: @Tia amazing. Can you post vendor contact + projector spec by EOD Fri?
Tia: Will do. Also recommend we rent backup mics and HDMI adapters.
Jen: Ops can schedule an AV dry-run with venue Thursday AM. I'll coordinate.
Samir: For rapid ideation scripts, can we try 'assumption sprint' + 'customer-journey flip'? short prompts.
Olivia: Yes. Drafting 4 micro-scripts (10 min each). Will share template.
Michael: Also need an accessibility checklist: captions + seating. @Jen can ops handle?
Jen: Yup. Adding to venue runbook.
Brandon: For facilitators — propose pairing a product PM + Eng lead for each room. Keeps scope negotiation real-time.
Olivia: Agree. Also we should define 'launch criteria' per initiative: impact metric, owner, and rollback plan. Short doc we'll use in decision gate.
Samir: I'll sketch a one-pager for launch criteria. Can we make it a slide per initiative?
Olivia: Perfect. Slot for slide deck in the agenda — 5 slides max per initiative.
calendar-bot: Event created: 'Annual planning — Day 0 AV dry-run' on 2024-06-12 09:00 — attendees: ops, AV lead, venue
Tia: Attached checklist snippet:
```
AV dry-run checklist:
- projector + sound test
- mics x3
- wifi SSID + guest creds tested
- Zoom fallback link pre-configured
- spare adapters bag
```
Olivia: Nice. Can you paste that into the shared drive? link: https://drive.redwood.example/annual-planning/runbook
Jen: Done. link updated. Also added seating map and emergency contact numbers.
Michael: For timeboxing, let's make a visible timer and a 'parking lot' board for out-of-scope items.
Olivia: adding to the facilitator script. Will circulate a printable facilitator cheat-sheet.
Samir: One more ask: can we reserve a quiet room with camera for async recording of sessions? We'll use clips for cross-team reviews.
Jen: Reserved room Quiet-2, includes tripod + table mic.
Olivia: Great. Next steps:
- @Tia post vendor & specs by Fri
- @Michael finalize facilitator rota by Mon
- @Samir draft launch criteria one-pager by Tue
- @Jen confirm AV dry-run booking + seating map
I'll send a short prework note to all attendees tomorrow with 3 prompts and 15-min prep.
Michael: LGTM :thumbsup: 
Tia: on it :+1: 
Olivia: Thanks all. If anything urgent ping me DMs.
